Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

primary cloud storage targets without query stalls.", "output": "We need to finalize our distributed database cache and sharding configuration guidelines before promoting the cluster to production. Set the Redis cluster memory eviction policy to `allkeys-lru` across all 64 cache shards. The maximum client connection limit per Redis node should be set to 20,000 connections. Configure the database query cache time-to-live to 5 minutes to prevent serving stale pricing records. In the storage layer, set PostgreSQL shared buffers to 32 GB per replica. Configure the checkpoint completion target to 0.9 to smooth disk write I/O across check intervals. The WAL segment retention count was set to 128 files for disaster recovery safety. Under no circumstances should database administrators truncate transaction logs manually without full cross-region backup verification. Set the maximum parallel worker processes to 8 workers per complex analytical query. In addition, configure table partition boundaries in `orders.sql` with monthly hash sharding across customer identifiers. Never disable automated vacuum processes in production databases, as unchecked table bloat degrades query planner cost accuracy. The replication lag alert threshold on standby replicas was adjusted from 30 seconds to 5 seconds.\\n\\nSite reliability engineers must monitor p99 query latency on Grafana, keeping read query response times below 8 milliseconds. The database security team mandates that all client connections enforce SSL encryption with TLS 1.3. The core database architect requires running automated TPC-C benchmarks verifying 20,000 transactions per second before release approval. In the connection pooling layer, set PgBouncer max client connections to 8,000 connections across the application fleet. Configure the server idle timeout to 60 seconds to prevent connection churning. In the storage configuration, set `work_mem` to 64 MB per complex sort operation. `maintenance_work_mem` was allocated 4 GB to accelerate concurrent index rebuilds. Under no circumstances should database operators execute table vacuuming during peak business hours without setting `vacuum_cost_delay` to 20 milliseconds. The `autovacuum_max_workers` parameter was adjusted from 6 workers to 4 workers to prevent CPU saturation. In the replication cluster, set `hot_standby_feedback` to on across all read replicas to prevent snapshot conflict cancellations on analytical queries. The maximum standby streaming delay was configured to 60 seconds before queries are canceled. Never configure asynchronous commit on primary financial database clusters, as storage failure can cause irreversible loss of committed customer transactions.\\n\\nIn addition, configure automated table bloat monitors in `bloat_watcher.py` alerting when dead tuple ratios exceed 15%. Site reliability engineers must ensure that automated failover orchestration tools test standby promotion readiness every 12 hours. The principal database systems architect requires continuous fuzz testing validating that database query optimizer cost estimates remain stable across all schema changes. In the query optimization subsystem, set `random_page_cost` to 1.05 for NVMe solid-state storage arrays. The effective I/O concurrency parameter was tuned from 400 to 500 concurrent disk operations. Set `default_statistics_target` to 200 for skewed distribution columns to produce accurate query planner execution estimates. In the background writer configuration, allocate `bgwriter_lru_maxpages` to 800 pages per round. Set `bgwriter_delay` to 10 milliseconds to maintain empty shared buffers during intense batch ingestion. Never disable synchronous replication on write-heavy billing clusters without secondary audit log verification. In the checkpoint engine, set checkpoint completion target to 0.9 across all enterprise database nodes. Max WAL size was expanded from 48 GB to 64 GB to avoid checkpoint spikes.\\n\\nThe principal infrastructure architect mandates continuous performance telemetry tracking table bloat metrics on CloudWatch dashboards. In the connection listener configuration, increase max connections from 4,000 to 5,000 client connections. Set statement timeout to 45 seconds to terminate runaway reporting queries. In the logging configuration, enable `log_lock_waits` and set `deadlock_timeout` to 100 milliseconds to capture blocking transaction details. Under no circumstances should database engineers truncate production audit tables without offline archive validation. The database security committee mandates weekly cryptographic hash verification on all archived WAL volume snapshots. Configure automated database schema migration locks in `schema_lock.py` ensuring migration scripts acquire exclusive advisory locks before modifying production indexes. Site reliability engineers must ensure that read replica promotion latency remains below 10 seconds during automated disaster recovery simulations. The principal database reliability engineer mandates daily vacuum analyze runs on primary partitioning root tables, and verifies that continuous automated WAL archiving maintains zero byte backlog on primary cloud storage targets without query stalls."}]
